info.title: Umrah Scanner API
info.description:
Customer, company and admin APIs for browsing Umrah programs and running the
booking lifecycle.

**Lead lifecycle**

`INTERESTED` → `PENDING_DEPOSIT_CONFIRMATION` → `DEPOSIT_PAID` →
`PENDING_FULL_PAYMENT_CONFIRMATION` → `FULLY_PAID` →
`PENDING_COMMISSION_CONFIRMATION` → `COMMISSION_PAID` → `CASHBACK_PAID`

Whoever reports a payment first decides the path: a customer report parks the
lead in the matching `PENDING_*` state until the other side confirms, while a
company (or, for commission, an admin) recording the payment itself goes
straight to the settled state.

**Money**

A lead's commission (`commissionPerTraveler` x billable travelers) and its
cashback are calculated once, at creation, and stored on the lead. Changing a
company's rate later affects new leads only. Commission is never exposed to
customers — they see cashback only.

Clients should drive their UI from each lead's `availableActions` rather than
inferring which steps are legal from the status.

put.description: Allowed only while the lead is before FULLY_PAID — read the lead's travelersEditable flag rather than comparing statuses. Does not reprice the lead: commission and cashback stay as they were fixed at creation.

delete.description: Refuses with 409 while any trip still uses it — mark it inactive (PUT with active=false) instead.

put.description: Unlike the self-service update, this may also change licenseNumber and works on a suspended company.

delete.description: Refuses with 409 while it has live bookings or an unsettled commission. Otherwise soft-deletes the company, its trips, and suspends its owner's account.

post.summary: Contact a company about a trip
post.description: Creates the lead and locks in its commission and cashback for the given traveler counts. Idempotent: contacting the same trip again returns the existing lead.

422.description: Profile incomplete, or trip not published

get.summary: List every hotel, including retired ones

get.description: Both status and search are optional — omit status to see every company, not just PENDING.

post.description: Provisions the owner's account if one does not already exist for ownerEmail, using a placeholder Google subject the owner's first real sign-in replaces. autoApprove=true skips the PENDING queue, since the admin creating it is itself the vetting step.

patch.summary: Report that I paid in full
patch.description: Allowed from DEPOSIT_PAID. Moves the lead to PENDING_FULL_PAYMENT_CONFIRMATION.

patch.summary: Report that I paid the deposit
patch.description: Moves the lead to PENDING_DEPOSIT_CONFIRMATION and asks the company to confirm.

Frees the customer's single preserved-trip slot. Allowed from every status except CASHBACK_PAID — read the lead's availableActions rather than comparing statuses. A note explaining why is required. Any commission the company owed on this lead is voided; money already paid to the company is not refunded by the platform.

409.description: Already cancelled, or the cashback has been paid

patch.summary: Report the commission as paid to the platform
patch.description: Moves the lead to PENDING_COMMISSION_CONFIRMATION. An admin must confirm before cashback can be released.

patch.summary: Mark the booking as fully paid
patch.description: Confirms a customer's full-payment report, or records it directly from DEPOSIT_PAID.
Confirms a customer's deposit report, or records the deposit directly from INTERESTED.

patch.summary: Reassign a trip to a different company
patch.description: Existing leads on this trip keep their original company and its pricing snapshot — only leads created after this call follow the new owner. The target company must be APPROVED.

patch.summary: Force a lead directly to any status
patch.description: Bypasses the normal report/confirm workflow entirely — a reason is required and both the customer and company are notified. Does NOT move the commission or cashback ledgers; use confirm-commission / pay-cashback for that. 409 if the lead is already in that status, or if reviving it out of CANCELLED/CASHBACK_PAID would give the customer a second preserved journey — cancel their other one first.
Allowed only from COMMISSION_PAID. Requires a wallet on the customer's profile.
Accepts a company's report, or records the payment directly from FULLY_PAID. Cashback becomes payable only after this.

patch.summary: Set a company's commission per traveler
patch.description: Admin-only. Companies can read this value on their own profile but can never change it. Takes effect for leads created after the change; existing leads keep the amounts they were priced with.

get.description: Visible to the lead's customer, its company, or any admin.
Public. Active hotels only — the trip form's picker. Pass city to scope it to Makkah or Madinah.

get.summary: The journey I am currently holding
get.description: A customer may preserve one trip at a time. Returns that lead, or null data if they have none — the trip-details button reads this to choose between "preserve", "preserved" and "you must cancel <other trip> first". A cancelled or completed journey frees the slot.
Public. A company picks one of these per trip.
Public. Use the returned id to scope /api/v1/airports.

Branches, contact numbers, licence and rating. Visible to a customer only once they have contacted this company about a trip, to the company itself, and to admins. Contains no commission or verification data — see the PublicCompany schema.

403.description: Caller has no lead with this company

get.description: Public. Pass countryId to scope the list — that is how a trip form offers only Egyptian airports where the itinerary needs one and only Saudi airports where it needs the other. Omit it for the full list.

get.summary: List leads, filtered any way the console needs
get.description: Every parameter is optional and they combine — e.g. companyId + createdFrom/createdTo for "this company's bookings this month". search matches customer name/phone or trip title/code.

get.summary: Get a lead with its trip and company detail embedded
get.description: Also see the trip he preserved and the trip's company in one call, rather than three.

get.summary: Compose a WhatsApp message with this trip's details
get.description: Returns the message text and a wa.me link pre-filled with it, addressed to the customer behind this lead. Nothing is sent automatically. lang defaults to Arabic; pass lang=en for English.

get.summary: Compose a WhatsApp message with the trip's company details
get.description: Same shape as the trip variant, addressed to the same customer, but with the operator's identity, licence, rating and branch contact numbers instead.

UpdateTravelersRequest.description: Corrected traveler counts. Rejected once the lead reaches DEPOSIT_PAID.

Lead.description: A booking request and its lifecycle. Commission fields are omitted for customers.

customer.description: Who is travelling. The company needs this to serve the booking; it never includes the payout wallet.

adultCount.description: Adults on the booking; always at least 1

travelerCount.description: Billable travelers — the count commission and cashback were calculated on

travelersEditable.description: Whether the traveler counts can still be changed. Gate the edit affordance on this flag rather than on the status, so a future change to the cut-off needs no client release.

cashbackAmount.description: EGP the customer receives after the company settles its commission

commissionAmount.description: EGP the company owes the platform. Null for customers.

commissionPerTraveler.description: The company's per-traveler rate at the time this lead was created. Null for customers.

availableActions.description: Exactly the actions this caller may perform on this lead right now

LeadAudit.description: Who reported and confirmed each payment step, and when.

LeadCustomer.description: Contact details for the traveller who opened the lead.

Company.description: A company profile. Only the owning company and admins can retrieve it.

commissionPerTraveler.description: EGP paid to the platform per billable traveler. Read-only for companies; only an admin can change it.

Airport.description: A reference airport, with the country that scopes it.

Currency.description: A currency a trip can be priced in.

symbol.description: Not localized — a currency symbol reads the same in either language

Hotel.description: A catalogue hotel. Embedded in a trip's detail and offered by the picker.

distanceToHaramM.description: Distance to the Haram (Makkah) or the Prophet's Mosque (Madinah)

canWalk.description: Whether that distance is walkable — an admin judgement, not a computed threshold

active.description: false once retired from the picker; trips already using it are unaffected

TripDetail.description: Full Umrah program details as shown on the program page.

outboundDepartureAirport.description: Leg 1 origin, in the traveler's own country

returnDepartureAirport.description: Leg 2 origin — not necessarily the airport they landed at

fastTrainIncluded.description: Haramain high-speed rail between Makkah and Madinah

cashbackPerTraveler.description: EGP each traveler earns back after the trip is paid for and the company settles up

TripHotel.description: The catalogue hotel this trip uses in one city, plus what this company offers around it.

freeBusIncluded.description: Whether THIS company runs a free shuttle to the Haram/Mosque on THIS package

ContactCompanyRequest.description: Traveler counts for a new booking request.

adultCount.description: Adults travelling; commission and cashback are calculated on this count

LeadActionRequest.description: Optional note recorded against the lifecycle step.

UpdateCompanyCommissionRequest.description: Admin-only. Applies to leads created after the change.

commissionPerTraveler.description: EGP the company pays the platform per billable traveler

Country.description: Reference country. Used to scope the airport picker.

PublicCompany.description: Customer-facing company profile. Contains no commission or verification data.

addresses.description: Branches, each with its city and its own contact number

City.description: An Egyptian governorate. Used to scope a company address.

AdminTripSummary.description: A trip row in the admin console — includes the owning company.

AdminLeadDetail.description: A lead with its full trip and company detail embedded.

WhatsAppMessage.description: A composed message and a wa.me click-to-chat link ready to send.

link.description: Opens WhatsApp with `message` pre-filled — the admin still presses send
